title: South Korea Faces Uncertainty After US Military Drill Cuts
subtitle: A sudden change in joint exercises raises questions about the future of the US-South Korea security partnership.

summary.en: South Korea has officially shortened its annual joint military exercises with the United States by six days. The decision followed a request from US President Donald Trump, who linked the move to his desire for better relations with North Korea. While some South Korean officials hope this could lead to more diplomatic talks, others fear it weakens national security. The sudden announcement has caused political tension within South Korea. Many experts now worry about the long-term strength of the alliance between the two countries.
summary.zh: 南韓已正式將與美國的年度聯合軍事演習縮短六天。這項決定源於美國總統川普的要求，他將此舉與他希望改善與北韓關係的願望連結在一起。雖然部分南韓官員希望此舉能促成更多外交對話，但其他人則擔心這會削弱國家安全。這項突如其來的宣布已在南韓內部引發政治緊張。許多專家現在對兩國聯盟的長期穩固性感到擔憂。

paragraphs.en: South Korea’s annual joint military exercises with the United States will be cut short by six days, the country’s defense ministry announced this week. The drills, known as Ulchi Freedom Shield, were originally scheduled to end on 27 August, but will now conclude on 21 August. According to the BBC, the change was made at the direct request of Washington.
paragraphs.zh: 南韓國防部本週宣布，南韓與美國的年度聯合軍事演習將縮短六天。這場名為「乙支自由護盾」（Ulchi Freedom Shield）的演習原定於八月二十七日結束，現在將提前至八月二十一日收場。根據英國廣播公司（BBC）報導，這項變動是應華府的直接要求所做出的。

paragraphs.en: This decision comes after US President Donald Trump expressed his frustration with South Korea on social media. President Trump described the military exercises as costly and inappropriate. He also publicly linked the decision to his disappointment that South Korea refused to help the United States with a military operation regarding Iran. "We have 39,000 soldiers over there guarding you from Kim Jong Un, your next door neighbour, and you're not going to help us on a very easy military operation in Iran," President Trump told reporters at the White House.
paragraphs.zh: 這項決定是在美國總統川普（Donald Trump）於社群媒體上表達對南韓的不滿後做出的。川普總統形容這些軍事演習既昂貴又不合時宜。他還公開將此決定與他對南韓拒絕協助美國進行一項關於伊朗的軍事行動感到失望連結在一起。川普總統在白宮告訴記者：「我們在那裡有三萬九千名士兵保護你們免受鄰國金正恩（Kim Jong-un）的威脅，而你們卻不願在伊朗的一項非常簡單的軍事行動上協助我們。」

paragraphs.en: For many in South Korea, the news was a surprise. The BBC reports that South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun told a parliamentary hearing that officials in Seoul were not aware of the plan before the president announced it. The sudden nature of the change has caused significant concern about the future of the defense pact, which is the foundation of the relationship between the two nations. This agreement serves as a promise that the US will help defend South Korea if it is attacked.
paragraphs.zh: 對於許多南韓人來說，這則消息令人震驚。BBC 報導指出，南韓外交部長趙兌烈（Cho Hyun）在國會聽證會上表示，首爾的官員在總統宣布該計畫之前並不知情。這種突如其來的變動引發了各界對兩國關係基石——國防條約未來的重大擔憂。這項協議是美國承諾在南韓遭受攻擊時協助防衛的保證。

paragraphs.en: The reaction in South Korea has been divided, reflecting the country's complex political landscape. According to The Guardian, conservative politicians have called the decision a "security disaster." They worry that the move makes South Korea look weak and leaves the country sidelined in important security decisions. Some newspapers in Seoul have even blamed the government of President Lee Jae Myung for the situation, suggesting that his policies made the country vulnerable to such pressure from the US.
paragraphs.zh: 南韓國內的反應呈現兩極化，反映出該國複雜的政治局勢。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，保守派政治人物稱此決定為「安全災難」。他們擔心此舉使南韓顯得軟弱，並導致該國在重要的安全決策中被邊緣化。首爾的一些報紙甚至將此情況歸咎於李在明（Lee Jae Myung）總統的政府，暗示他的政策使國家容易受到來自美國的此類壓力。

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, some progressive groups and media outlets have a different view. The Guardian noted that some supporters of the current government believe the reduction in military activity could help create a better atmosphere for future talks with North Korea. President Lee has long supported the idea of reducing military posturing to encourage dialogue. However, even those who agree with the goal of the policy have criticized the way President Trump delivered the news, calling it disrespectful and one-sided.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，一些進步派團體和媒體則有不同的看法。《衛報》指出，現任政府的一些支持者認為，減少軍事活動可能有助於為未來與北韓的談判創造更好的氛圍。李總統長期以來一直支持減少軍事對峙以鼓勵對話的理念。然而，即使是那些認同該政策目標的人，也批評了川普總統傳達消息的方式，稱其不尊重且過於單方面。

paragraphs.en: North Korea has also responded to the changes. While the North Korean leader’s sister, Kim Yo-Jong, stated that the reduction of the drill was not "something that merits comment," she also warned that the move does not change the "hostile and aggressive essence" of the exercises. She further clarified that there has been no official communication between the leaders of the US and North Korea regarding this specific decision, despite President Trump’s recent claims that he expects to meet Kim Jong Un later this year.
paragraphs.zh: 北韓也對這些變動做出了回應。雖然北韓領導人的胞妹金與正（Kim Yo-Jong）表示，演習縮短「不值得評論」，但她也警告說，此舉並未改變演習「敵對且具侵略性的本質」。她進一步澄清，儘管川普總統近期聲稱預計今年稍晚會與金正恩會面，但美朝兩國領導人之間並未就此特定決定進行任何官方溝通。

paragraphs.en: This event has caused many experts to question the reliability of the United States as an ally. Professor Jaechun Kim from Sogang University in Seoul explained that the alliance is built on trust. He argued that the current situation reinforces the impression that the US views its international obligations through a "highly transactional lens." This means the US may only support its allies if it receives something in return, which creates doubt about long-term security commitments.
paragraphs.zh: 此事件導致許多專家質疑美國作為盟友的可靠性。首爾西江大學（Sogang University）的教授金在春（Jaechun Kim）解釋說，聯盟是建立在信任之上的。他認為，當前的情況加深了美國以「高度交易導向」的視角看待其國際義務的印象。這意味著美國可能只有在獲得回報時才會支持其盟友，這對長期的安全承諾產生了懷疑。

paragraphs.en: In response to these events, President Lee has renewed his calls for South Korea to take more responsibility for its own defense. He is pushing for faster progress on programs that would give South Korea more control over its own military operations during wartime. This shift suggests that Seoul is trying to reduce its reliance on the United States as it faces an uncertain future.
paragraphs.zh: 針對這些事件，李總統重申南韓應為自身國防承擔更多責任的呼籲。他正推動加速相關計畫的進度，以使南韓在戰時能對自身的軍事行動擁有更多控制權。這種轉變顯示首爾在面對不確定的未來時，正試圖減少對美國的依賴。

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, the situation remains tense. While the reduction of the drills is seen by some as a potential opening for diplomacy, the way it was handled has clearly strained the relationship between Seoul and Washington. As the two nations move forward, the challenge will be to maintain a strong defense while navigating the changing priorities of the US government. For now, the people of South Korea are left watching closely to see how these political shifts will affect their safety and their country's place on the world stage.
paragraphs.zh: 總體而言，局勢依然緊張。雖然演習的縮減被部分人士視為外交的潛在契機，但其處理方式顯然已使首爾與華府之間的關係變得緊繃。隨著兩國向前邁進，挑戰將在於如何在應對美國政府不斷變化的優先事項的同時，維持強大的國防。目前，南韓民眾正密切關注這些政治轉變將如何影響他們的安全以及國家在世界舞台上的地位。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To make something end earlier than originally planned.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個常見的片語，但容易與「切斷」混淆，這裡指時間上的縮減。文中：South Korea’s annual joint military exercises with the United States will be cut short by six days, the country’s defense ministry announced this week.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be forced into a position where one has less influence or importance.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 被邊緣化、被排除在核心之外。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（體育比賽的邊線），這裡作動詞，形容在決策中被忽視。文中：They worry that the move makes South Korea look weak and leaves the country sidelined in important security decisions.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A way of looking at or thinking about a situation.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（鏡頭、鏡片），這裡比喻為看待事物的「視角」。文中：He argued that the current situation reinforces the impression that the US views its international obligations through a "highly transactional lens."

quiz.question: What reason did President Trump provide for his frustration regarding the joint military exercises?

options.A: He believed the exercises were ineffective at deterring North Korean aggression.
options.B: He felt South Korea failed to support the US in a military operation involving Iran.
options.C: He was concerned about the safety of the 39,000 US soldiers stationed in the region.
options.D: He wanted to save money by shortening the duration of the drills.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，川普總統明確表示對南韓拒絕在伊朗軍事行動中提供協助感到失望，並將此與縮短軍演的決定連結起來。選項 A 文中未提及；選項 C 雖然提到士兵數量，但並非他「感到挫折」的主要原因；選項 D 雖然川普稱軍演「昂貴」，但這只是描述，並非他對南韓不滿的核心理由。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the state of communication between the US and South Korean governments during this event?

options.A: The two nations coordinated the decision through formal diplomatic channels.
options.B: The US government consulted with South Korean officials before the public announcement.
options.C: There was a significant lack of transparency and prior notice given to South Korean officials.
options.D: The South Korean government requested the change to improve relations with North Korea.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段，南韓外交部長 Cho Hyun 在國會聽證會上表示，首爾官員在總統宣布前並不知情，這顯示兩國政府間缺乏溝通與透明度。選項 A 與 B 與文中「突然性」的描述矛盾；選項 D 雖然提到部分進步派人士認為此舉有助於對話，但這並非南韓政府主動要求的，而是川普要求的。

quiz.question: In the seventh paragraph, what does the phrase 'highly transactional lens' imply about the US approach to its alliances?

options.A: The US views alliances as partnerships based on mutual financial gain and exchange.
options.B: The US is focused on long-term security commitments regardless of the cost.
options.C: The US is prioritizing the needs of its allies over its own national interests.
options.D: The US is trying to maintain a neutral stance in global political conflicts.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到「transactional lens」意指將盟友關係視為一種「交易」，即只有在獲得回報時才提供支持。這與選項 A 的描述相符。選項 B 與文意相反；選項 C 錯誤，因為文中強調的是美國只在有回報時才行動，而非優先考慮盟友；選項 D 與「交易性」的定義不符。

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the central theme of the article?

options.A: The reduction of US-South Korea military drills is a positive step toward peace on the Korean Peninsula.
options.B: South Korea is planning to end its long-standing defense pact with the United States.
options.C: The unilateral decision to cut military drills has strained US-South Korea relations and created uncertainty about the alliance.
options.D: President Trump's decision to cut drills was primarily motivated by his desire to meet with Kim Jong Un.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文的核心在於探討美國單方面縮減軍演對南韓造成的政治衝擊、兩國關係的緊張，以及對未來軍事同盟可靠性的質疑。選項 A 只涵蓋了部分觀點；選項 B 過度推論，文中僅提到南韓想增加國防自主，而非廢除盟約；選項 D 並非文章主旨，只是背景資訊的一部分。
